bullet_points: Load halo catalogs for all 10 realizations.
Implement a K-function estimator for periodic boxes.
Calculate the L-function to linearize the K-function.
Produce a plot comparing the mean L-function (averaged over all 10 realizations) against the CSR theoretical expectation L(r) - r = 0, with shaded uncertainty bands.
Print the mean and standard deviation of the L-function deviation at representative radii (10, 20, 50 Mpc/h).
Save the results to disk for subsequent analysis.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Compute Ripley’s K-function and L-function for the halo catalogs to characterize the parent process and compare against Complete Spatial Randomness (CSR).

bullet_points: Implement a VPF estimator using random sphere placement.
Compute $P_0(r)$ for $r \in [1, 30]$ Mpc/h.
Derive and overplot the theoretical Poisson VPF ($P_0(r) = \exp(-n \cdot \frac{4}{3} \pi r^3)$) alongside the empirical VPF.
Quantify the deviation between the empirical and Poisson VPF at each radius bin by computing a normalized residual.
Print these residuals explicitly to assess hierarchy leakage.
Save the empirical VPF values and the variance across realizations.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Compute the empirical VPF, $P_0(r)$, for the galaxy catalogs and compare against the theoretical Neyman-Scott and Poisson VPFs.

bullet_points: Filter galaxies to isolate satellites in massive halos.
Perform Strauss process likelihood estimation per-halo for each halo with at least 3 satellites.
Fit the repulsion radius $R$ and interaction parameter $\gamma$ for each qualifying halo.
Save and print the distribution of fitted parameters across halos and realizations (mean, median, standard deviation of $R$ and $\gamma$).
sub_tasks.sub_task: Estimate interaction parameters for satellite-satellite pairs within host halos ($M > 10^{13} M_\odot/h$).

bullet_points: Calculate the mean luminosity as a function of normalized halo-centric distance ($r/R_{vir}$) separately for centrals and satellites.
Produce a plot showing these mean luminosity profiles.
Compute the Spearman rank correlation between luminosity and distance for each realization.
Print the Spearman correlation coefficient and its p-value for each realization, as well as the mean across realizations, distinguishing between central and satellite populations.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Test for spatial-mark independence by analyzing the luminosity mark $f(m|x)$ relative to halo-centric distance.

bullet_points: Compute $G(r)$ (nearest neighbor) and $F(r)$ (empty space) functions.
Generate a shuffled catalog by re-assigning satellite positions within their host halos.
Compute the J-function for both original and shuffled catalogs averaged over all 10 realizations with uncertainty bands.
Plot the J-functions and print the radius at which $J(r)$ first deviates significantly from 1 (the CSR expectation) for both catalogs.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Compute the J-function for the galaxy catalog and compare it against a shuffled (randomized) satellite distribution.

bullet_points: Load all intermediate results from previous steps.
Compute the mean and covariance (using Jackknife resampling) for VPF, K-function, J-function, and Gibbs parameters.
Produce a single multi-panel summary figure containing the mean K/L-function, VPF, J-function, and mark correlation profiles with jackknife error bars.
Print the full jackknife covariance matrix diagonal (variances) for each statistic.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Aggregate all computed statistics across the 10 realizations and compute robust covariance matrices.

bullet_points: Perform a regression analysis between VPF deviations and Strauss interaction parameters.
Print the Pearson and Spearman correlation coefficients between the VPF deviation metric and the Strauss $\gamma$ parameter across realizations, along with their p-values.
Generate a scatter plot of these two quantities with a linear regression line.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Perform a joint analysis to correlate VPF "leakage" with Gibbs "repulsion" parameters.

bullet_points: Structure the Results section with clearly labeled subsections: Halo Parent Process, VPF Hierarchy, Local Gibbs Analysis, Mark Independence, J-function, and Joint Analysis.
Explicitly reference all numerical values printed in previous steps (L-function deviations, VPF residuals, Spearman correlations, Strauss parameters, J-function crossing scales).
Interpret the results from the K-function, VPF, and J-function analyses.
Discuss the validity of the separable intensity model and the impact of luminosity marks.
Summarize the effective repulsion radii and the degree of hierarchy leakage.
Provide a comprehensive assessment of the galaxy distribution's complexity relative to the HOD model.
sub_tasks.sub_task: Write the full Results section of the report, synthesizing all findings and documenting the limitations of the Neyman-Scott assumption.
